steps.step: page opens on the scene: title, hook, real proof chips, default job (A, centre lens, reach 0)
audio: the piece makes no sound; no <audio>/<video>, and nothing has started a sound
pick the gene set "Folds and tracts": job, gene chips and notes switch to set B
pick one gene (C1ql2): chip pressed, the mouse and tally speak about that gene only
drag the lens from the centre to the front: it snaps to the computed front-lens job
step the lens with the arrow keys: right twice reaches the back lens
push reach to 0.5: only one such job exists, so the view settles on it and says so
"0 · local" brings reach 0 back (the dead-control report was the already-selected default)
game outcome: catch every ghost in the view (button and C key) until "all caught"
hold "Hold: measured": the measurement shows (no ghosts in it), release returns the blur
probe a pixel: pointing inside the lens reads measured and blurred values for all three genes
wipe compare: the tool turns on, the divider follows a drag, the Measured tag shows
the sprite overlay (#fx, flagged by the dead-control scan) is click-through: its drag moves the wipe on the slide
"Sweep the wipe" animates the divider and "Pause" stops it
Scene / Data: Data shows the exact per-gene table from the job and hides the cast; Scene brings it back
science drawers open, and their numbers are computed from the job data
restored words: no "Bonus" anywhere, earlier sub, steps, Mask label and claims text, all under titled sections
earlier words kept: every text run of the pre-sprite page (history/template.pre_sprite.html) is on the page now
every restored graph renders: the slide, Figure 1 (both panes) and the ghost-signal bars of the per-gene table
The data: figure 1 draws measured | blurred for the view, follows the controls, and its probe reads one pixel in both
Jobs and credits: one row per job, the slide's job is marked, Show puts another job on the slide
share: set a view, copy its link; the hash holds the full state
reload with the hash (same tab): the exact view is restored
open the shared link in a fresh tab: same view, and sharing again yields the same token
navigation: brand bar and nav link to the hub; prev is 14, next is 16; the jump list holds all 22
phone width (375 px): no horizontal scroll, the instrument and the nav fit
no sound ever started, no page errors, no failed or off-site requests
